layers.name: Elm interface
layers.summary: Main coordinates desktop interaction, while Bar and Popup render presentations through The Elm Architecture.

layers.name: JavaScript adapters
layers.summary: JavaScript connects Elm ports to browser input, native callbacks, presentation acknowledgments, and preview transport.

layers.name: Desktop runtime
layers.summary: The desktop build runs a C/C++ GTK host, WebKitGTK, native preview support, and a Python adapter subprocess.

layers.name: Hyprland integration
layers.summary: Hyprland, its authority plugin, and its display backend manage windows, input, workspaces, and desktop composition.

layers.name: Standalone Haskell packages
layers.summary: Five Haskell packages provide ELF observation, held documents, process custody, the checked protocol boundary and a controlled bootstrap, independently of the desktop build.

layers.name: Applications and desktop services
layers.summary: Applications, XWayland, desktop services, and local storage supply the capabilities exposed by Warlock.

nodes.name: Main controller
nodes.summary: Owns desktop interaction state and publishes presentations, native requests, and focus targets from a hidden controller document.

nodes.name: Bar
nodes.summary: Renders an output's taskbar, validates captured actions, and delivers announcements assigned to that surface.

nodes.name: Popup
nodes.summary: Renders the shared popup and manages local text composition, validated actions, announcements, and preview lifecycles.
renders: Task View and workspace transfer controls
Window previews and fallbacks within popup panels

nodes.name: adapter.js
nodes.summary: Starts Elm.Main and connects its ports to native callbacks and the WebKit script message handler.

nodes.name: bar-adapter.js
nodes.summary: Starts Elm.Bar, routes its ports, acknowledges presentation and focus, and keeps keyboard selection visible.

nodes.name: popup-adapter.js
nodes.summary: Starts Elm.Popup, orders committed queries after presentation acknowledgment, maintains focus, and transports preview commands and paint acknowledgments.

nodes.name: context.js
nodes.summary: Captures context-menu gestures and menu navigation with the originating control and current presentation identity.

nodes.name: activation.js
nodes.summary: Preserves the captured control through press and release and rejects stale, cancelled, or mismatched activation gestures.

nodes.name: appearance.js
nodes.summary: Copies committed Elm appearance attributes to the document root so CSS applies theme, text scale, effects, and transparency.

nodes.name: Shared GTK native host
nodes.summary: Owns the hidden controller, output taskbars, popup placement, input admission, backend subprocess, admission journal, and GTK crash recovery.
renders: GTK recovery bar with Desktop display stopped. and Restart

nodes.name: WebKitGTK renderer
nodes.language: C/C++ with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
nodes.summary: Executes compiled Elm and JavaScript in sandboxed WebViews and paints their HTML and CSS inside GTK surfaces.

nodes.name: Native preview provider
nodes.summary: Runs inside the host to obtain compositor captures, retain preview resources and receipts, and serve preview images and fallback icons.

nodes.name: Adapter daemon
nodes.summary: Runs as the host's child process to authenticate compositor requests, maintain recovery records, and connect desktop services and preferences.

nodes.name: Notification service
nodes.summary: Runs in a Gio thread inside the adapter process to acquire the notification D-Bus name and maintain bounded notification history.

nodes.name: Hyprland observation authority plugin
nodes.summary: Runs inside Hyprland to assign window identities, report native facts, execute checked operations, route shortcuts, and provide preview captures.

nodes.name: Hyprland on Omarchy
nodes.summary: Composes shell and application surfaces and owns native focus, input, workspaces, and window geometry on the Omarchy desktop.
renders: Composited desktop containing Warlock surfaces and application windows

nodes.name: Aquamarine display backend
nodes.summary: Supplies Hyprland's output buffers and presentation backend, including the repository's nested Wayland backend.

nodes.name: XWayland
nodes.summary: Connects X11 applications to the Wayland desktop and exposes their surfaces, metadata, lifecycle, and configuration requests to Hyprland.

nodes.name: Preview policy worker
nodes.summary: A headless Elm worker that the native host runs (native/elm-preview-policy.cpp) to apply Warlock's window preview policy.

nodes.name: NativePreviewAdmission
nodes.summary: Renders and validates the initial popup presentation before the controlled-preview QA path installs its visual receiver.
renders: Initial controlled-preview popup in QA mode

nodes.name: NativePreviewRenderer
nodes.summary: Renders visual snapshots bound to a native grant and acknowledges accepted sequences in the controlled-preview QA path.
renders: Controlled-preview popup and preview visuals in QA mode

nodes.name: controlled-popup-adapter.js
nodes.summary: Connects the admission and visual-receiver Elm programs to native initialization, snapshots, actions, and acknowledgments in controlled-preview QA mode.

nodes.name: Native preview control outbox
nodes.summary: Runs in the host's JavaScriptCore context to retain exact preview command tickets until delivery receipts arrive in controlled-preview QA mode.

nodes.name: elf-observation
nodes.summary: Parses captured GNU readelf output and resolves declared dependency graphs with explicit bounds and unresolved obligations as a standalone library.

nodes.name: held-document
nodes.summary: Reads identity-checked snapshots through held file descriptors and prepares hash-verified HTML with script and style hashes as a standalone library.

nodes.name: process-custody
nodes.summary: Controls bounded tool execution and selected child-process sessions with deadlines, descriptor ownership, transfer records, and cleanup tracking as a standalone library.

nodes.name: Installed applications
nodes.summary: Supply desktop entries, Wayland or X11 windows, declared actions, and notifications while owning their window contents.

nodes.name: Omarchy Files
nodes.summary: Provides the installed Files application that Warlock opens or navigates through verified Quickshell instance commands.

nodes.name: PulseAudio-compatible audio service
nodes.summary: Reports the default audio sink and applies volume or mute changes through the selected local audio server.

nodes.name: NetworkManager
nodes.summary: Supplies network state and permissions and handles explicit networking enable or disable requests.

nodes.name: systemd-logind
nodes.summary: Reports session and power capabilities and handles lock, logout, suspend, reboot, and power-off requests.

nodes.name: Desktop portal and GTK motion preference
nodes.summary: Supplies the host's motion preference through the desktop portal with GTK animation settings as the fallback.

nodes.name: Desktop data and Warlock state
nodes.summary: Stores desktop data, saved preferences, the native host's admission records, and the adapter's separate recovery ledgers.

nodes.name: protocol
nodes.summary: Checks bounded bytes into a versioned protocol envelope, records a refusal reason for rejected input, and provides a caller-owned framed socket transport.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: A controlled bootstrap that selects a held executable, keeps custody of the process it starts, and authenticates the current session's peer before admitting a frame.
